title: He Calls the Stars by Name
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler of wonder, and tonight is Isaiah telling people who feel small to lift up their eyes: Heavenly Father brings out the stars one by one and calls each by name, which is exactly what Wren does lying on the driveway, counting stars and asking if they have names.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she is the one who stops and ponders how big Heavenly Father is. In Wren’s world today: she lies on the driveway after dinner with her coral red jacket zipped up. She counts nine stars, loses count, and starts over again. She asks if the stars have names, and her mom says every one. Just like Isaiah asking the people to lift up their eyes, Wren learned that wondering is a kind of praying.
